test_DataPipeline_count_basic: test the DataPipeline.count operation that generates a sequence of integers starting from a given value
test_DataPipeline_count_with_step: test the DataPipeline.count operation with a custom step value greater than one
test_DataPipeline_state_save_restore: test the DataPipeline state_dict and load_state_dict methods for saving and restoring pipeline state
test_DataPipeline_reset: test the DataPipeline reset method that reinitializes the pipeline to its starting state
test_DataPipeline_take_and_return: test the DataPipeline take and and_return methods for limiting and finalizing the pipeline
